decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen sits squarely on the firm's core confectionery know-how and has repeatedly won gold from the German Bread Institute, which gives management clear, interpretable evidence of quality to build on.

The dark barley malt rye bread draws on established rye-baking expertise and, unlike the other new breads, stayed on its own page through 2024, suggesting the firm judged it worth keeping, though it shows no explicit success signal.

The marzipan stollen closely builds on the firm's seasonal stollen competence and existing recipes, and its continued page presence fits an established Christmas assortment the firm can easily assess and refine.
